# Footer

Per Figma spec: node-id=111-227939 Simple footer with version, copyright, and terms - no border/stroke

**Import:** `import { Footer } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/Footer/Footer.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/Footer/Footer.stories.jsx` — Overview, CustomContent, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/Footer/Footer.mdx`

## Usage

Use `Footer` once, at the bottom of a Page, for the legal and version line. It is a quiet footnote, not navigation: do not put actions or a link list in it.

## Best practices

### One line of copyright. {#one-line-of-copyright}

The footer is a single quiet line; long legal text belongs on its own page.

Do: Short copyright line.
Don't: A legal paragraph that crowds the bar.

### Name the link for where it goes. {#name-the-link-for-where-it-goes}

The terms link is read out of context, so its label has to stand alone.

Do: “Terms of Use” names where the link goes.
Don't: “Click here” says nothing out of context.

### Version is a short tag. {#version-is-a-short-tag}

The version reads like a build stamp, not a sentence.

Do: A short tag: v5.2.0.
Don't: A sentence about the build.

### Set `version` and `termsUrl` from the app, not the defaults. {#set-version-and-termsurl-from-the-app-not-the-defaults}

The defaults are placeholders. Pass the running version and the real terms address.

```jsx
<Footer version={appVersion} termsUrl="/terms" />
```

### Text and color come from tokens. {#text-and-color-come-from-tokens}

The line uses the small body style and `--ds-text`; the terms link uses `--ds-link`. Pass `style` only to change spacing.

## Accessibility

- **A landmark.** It renders a `<footer>`, which assistive technology announces as the page's content information.
- **A real link.** The terms text is an `<a>` with `termsUrl` as its `href`, so it is keyboard focusable and announced as a link.

## Related

- For the page's top edge, use `PageHeader`.
- For legal text inside a form or card, use body text, not `Footer`.

Same group: `Accordion` · `Carousel` · `PageHeader` · `Panel` · `ScrollBar` · `VisuallyHidden`

## Parts

1. **Version.** The product version, first.
2. **Copyright.** The copyright line.
3. **Terms link.** The only control in the footer.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Small text in `--ds-text`; the link in `--ds-link`, underlined. |
| Hovered | The link in `--ds-link-pressed`. |
| Pressed | The link in `--ds-link-pressed`. |
| Focused | A 2px ring 2px off the link. |
| Disabled | A footer has no disabled state. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Line | `--body-small`, `--ds-text`. |
| Link | `--ds-link`; `--ds-link-pressed` on hover and press. |
| Padding | `--pad-y-lg` below the line. |
| Link corner | `--radius-sm`, which shapes the focus ring. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, `--focus-ring-width` wide and offset. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write the version as "v5.2.0". | Write "Version 5.2.0 (build 4411)". |
| Keep the copyright line to the owner and the year. | Add marketing copy or a tagline. |
| Name the link for where it goes: "Terms of Use". | Name it "Click here". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `version` | string | `'v5.2.0'` | The product version, shown first. |
| `copyright` | string | `'Copyright © Carnegie Mellon University 2024'` | The copyright line. |
| `termsText` | string | `'Terms of Use'` | The label of the terms link. |
| `termsUrl` | string | `'#'` | Where the terms link goes. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
